fields.name: Fractal Design Define 7 White
fields.description: ATX mid-tower with sound-damping panels and a modular interior. Three 140 mm fans included, tempered-glass or solid side panel options, room for large coolers and many drives.

fields.cooling_system: 3x 140 mm Dynamic X2 GP-14 fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: NZXT H510i Black
fields.description: ATX mid-tower with a steel front and tempered-glass side panel. Two 120 mm fans, an RGB and fan controller and clean cable routing. A good case for a compact gaming build.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 1x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 2x 120 mm Aer F fans included (front and rear); supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans

fields.name: be quiet! Dark Base Pro 900 Rev. 2 White
fields.description: Large full-tower case for ATX and E-ATX boards. Sound-dampening panels, three 140 mm fans, a tempered-glass side panel and a movable drive cage. For high-end builds.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C, 2x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 3x 140 mm fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans and large radiators

fields.name: Lian Li O11 Dynamic Mini White
fields.description: Compact tower with a tempered-glass front and side for showing off the parts. Takes Micro ATX and Mini-ITX boards, long graphics cards and radiators up to 360 mm. Fans are not included.

fields.cooling_system: Fans not included; supports 120 mm fans and radiators up to 360 mm

fields.name: Corsair iCUE 4000X RGB White
fields.description: ATX mid-tower with a tempered-glass side panel, a high-airflow front and three RGB fans controlled through iCUE. Clean cable routing and good room for radiators.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 1x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 3x 120 mm AF120 RGB ELITE fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: Fractal Design Meshify C Black
fields.description: Compact ATX mid-tower with a mesh front for strong airflow and a tempered-glass side panel. Two 120 mm fans included. A simple, quiet case for a gaming PC.

fields.cooling_system: 2x 120 mm Dynamic X2 GP-12 fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans

fields.name: Cooler Master MasterBox TD500 Mesh White
fields.description: ATX mid-tower with a mesh front panel, a tempered-glass side panel and three addressable RGB fans. Good airflow and a clean look for a mid-range gaming PC.

fields.cooling_system: 3x 120 mm ARGB fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: ASUS ROG Strix Helios White
fields.description: Full-tower case for E-ATX, ATX and smaller boards with a tempered-glass side panel, RGB lighting and three 140 mm fans. Lots of room for water cooling and long graphics cards.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 4x USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type-A, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 3x 140 mm fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: NZXT H1 V2 White
fields.description: Compact Mini-ITX tower with a built-in 140 mm liquid cooler and a 750 W SFX power supply. The graphics card is mounted on a riser. A neat case for a small gaming PC.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: Built-in 140 mm AIO liquid cooler; additional fans not supported

fields.name: Fractal Design Define 7 Compact White
fields.description: Compact ATX mid-tower with sound-damping panels and a flexible interior. Two 140 mm fans included. Smaller than the Define 7 but still takes long graphics cards.

fields.front_panel_ports: 2x USB 3.0 Type-A, 1x USB Type-C, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 2x 140 mm Dynamic X2 GP-14 fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans
